verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it supports "both single server setups and replication configurations" and runs on Kubernetes with clustered-capable databases such as TiDB, PostgreSQL and MySQL. That is a first-party claim of replicated deployment, but it is a single marketing line with no detail on how high availability actually works. Missing for 10: documented HA architecture (multi-node app servers, shared repo/LFS storage, session/queue/cache sharing), failover and load-balancing guidance, setup docs for replication, and independent or hands-on confirmation of an HA deployment.
